_readme: Every assumption the Team Builder makes, in one place. The page shows these to users.

leagueMinimum.note: 2026 minimum. The 2027 figure depends on the next labor agreement, so pre-arb salaries are an estimate.

roughArbitration.note: Only for arbitration players MLBTR didn't project: a flat figure by arbitration year, or last year's pay if higher.

optionDefaults.note: Club and player options start exercised. Mutual options start declined with the buyout counted, because both sides almost never pick one up (Will, 2026-10-03).

projections.fallbackNote: Players Steamer doesn't project (some NPB and KBO postings, like Hiromi Itoh in 2026-11) use FanGraphs' Depth Charts projection instead, and say so. Added 2026-11-10.
projections.label: Steamer projection for 2027
projections.note: Minor leaguers use Steamer's full-time version (600 PA, 200 IP as a starter or 65 in relief), because plain Steamer gives most of them almost no big-league time.

dollarsPerWar.note: A one-year price per projected WAR, used to pre-fill free-agent signings. Calibrated against this year's pending free agents on market salaries (Grisham's $22M qualifying offer at 2.8 WAR, Torres, Suzuki, Happ: about $8-9M per projected WAR). FanGraphs' 2026 free-agent study found $11.23M, but that is the average annual value over multi-year deals, during which a player's WAR is expected to decline, so it overstates a single season. Changed from $11.2M on 2026-10-14 after Will spotted Grisham at $31.6M.

projectedRecord.note: Projected wins = replacement-level wins (a .294 team, FanGraphs' convention) + WAR. Our team WAR is a straight sum of each 40-man, which overstates, so every team's WAR is scaled by the same factor until the league's wins add up to a .500 league: the average team comes out 81-81 (about 1,000 WAR league-wide, FanGraphs' figure).

playingTime.note: A season's playing time per spot, used to turn individual projections into a team total like a depth chart: each spot is filled by the best players there (by WAR per PA or per inning), leftovers fill other gaps, and below-replacement players are left out. Since 2026-11-05 a hitter counts at every position he's listed at ("2b-lf" is 2B and LF), best players placed first, and leftover time goes to DH and the corners but never to catcher (Altuve was being counted behind the plate once Arraez took second). About 6,200 PA and 1,450 innings in all. Added 2026-10-14 after Will questioned the A's leading on summed WAR. Rotation/bullpen split 850/600 innings, close to how starters and relievers have split them in recent seasons, and no one pitcher counts for more than 75 innings in the bullpen (starter prospects listed as plain RHP/LHP were each being counted for ~100 relief innings). Both added 2026-10-15 after Will asked how many innings the Twins' seven 1-WAR starters would throw.

offseason.note: The offseason simulation (lib/team-builder/offseason.ts). Each team's attitude sets its budget (its real 2026 payroll from payrolls-2026.json x the factor, but at least what it already owes for 2027 plus the cushion), how hard it holds on to options and arbitration players (it keeps one whose salary is under WAR x $/WAR x keepFactor, and only non-tenders when he costs at least nonTenderMargin more than that), how much a free agent must add to its depth-chart WAR before it bids and how many it signs, how eager it is against other bidders, and whether it sells veterans (age floor, how many) or buys them. Free agents nobody signs go round again at lower prices (priceRounds, fractions of WAR x $/WAR). Added 2026-11-05. Reworked 2026-11-06 after Will noticed teams made few moves: budgets had been 2027 commitments plus a small cushion (the 2026 payroll summed from today's sheets misses everyone who left), which left 20 of 30 teams $10M or less and only ~9 of the top 40 free agents signing. With real 2026 payrolls, falling prices and higher signing caps for rebuilding and tanking teams, ~28 of the top 40 sign and league payroll ends ~6% above 2026.

bargain.note: In the last price round a team will go this far over its budget, and sign this many more than its plan's limit, for a bargain. Added 2026-11-06 so solid veterans don't go unsigned just because every budget was spent by the time their price fell.

season.note: Playing out the 2027 season in the batch simulation script (lib/team-builder/season.ts). A team's true strength is its projection plus a normal error with this standard deviation in wins, for what projections can't see (injuries, breakouts, collapses); then every game of a 162-game balanced schedule is played (log5), which adds the usual game-to-game luck of about 6 wins. Preseason projections typically miss final records by 8-9 wins, so 5 wins of talent error plus game luck lands in that range. Added 2026-11-06 so a batch gives playoff and title odds.
